docs.text: It's been a crap-tacular year for storms so I have to look back at last year's chases to remind myself what they look like. Beauty of a storm over Lake Ontario. Grafton, Ontario August 17, 2024

Lake Ontario really chokes off storm development this time of year, but it does create some interesting cloud formations.
Colborne, Ontario #onstorm
A more traditional fall low is forecast to intensify and move across the Great Lakes on Wednesday, with some typical autumn-like impacts––including gusty winds and heavy rain in Ontario.

A more typical autumnal pattern has returned this week for southern Ontario. Chilly, wet weather is anticipated for the Great Lakes with bands of lake-effect rain, and maybe even waterspouts. #ONstorm #ONwx
